_readme: Lines she uses for check-ins (and when there is no Claude key). No emojis.

morning.text: you're here. good. the day can start now
morning john. try not to hate everyone before 9

howsYourDay.text: how's the day treating you. honestly
is it a good day or a pretend good day

lunch.text: lunch. you're not a plant, you can't live on sunlight
eat. the work will still be there, sadly
did you eat or are you running on spite again

water.text: when did you last drink water. don't lie

goodbye.text: okay that's enough work for today
done. close the laptop before it notices
go home john. the emails can wait till tomorrow

tap.text: i was busy doing nothing, thanks
stop poking me and go work

chatter.text: random thought. tomorrow is a very patient liar
i was going to say something deep but i forgot it
fun fact, nobody asked. still telling you
are you working or pretending, be honest

afterCall.text: call's done. did it go okay or do we need to talk about it
that was a long one. survived?

workingLate.text: it's past 4. why are you still here
working late again. go home soon ok
the work isn't going anywhere. you should though
